run_profile_timing: run a pybullet script that logs profile timings to a JSON file viewable in Chrome about://tracing
start_state_logging: start pybullet state logging for profile timings with a specified output JSON file path
submit_profile_timing: submit a named profile timing event to the active pybullet state logging session
stop_state_logging: stop an active pybullet state logging session using its log ID handle
configure_debug_visualizer: configure the pybullet debug visualizer to enable single step rendering mode
